The floating library

By: Anina Peens | Commission

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
a Floating library just hit our shores and it is entertaining young and old at the Cape Town Waterfront. We take a look inside.

Unique Selling Point:
Its the biggest floating library in the world and it comes all the way from Germany. As part of its trip around Africa, it just anchored on Cape Town shores.

Summary:
We take a look inside the Logos Hope floating library. With three stories of books, the ship offers a whimsical visit to the world of stories. We follow the excitement of an avid group of readers from the Cape Flats to the V&A waterfront as they explore a world of books they have never seen before.

Further information:
The Hot spot library is a pop-up library in Kraaifontein just outside Cape Town. Started in 2017, membership has grown from only 30 children to over 800 in 2024. It aims to inspire and keep children off the streets. It tries to lure children into reading and all its benefits rather than choosing a life of gangsterism and drugs. We follow an avid reader whose life was changed by the Hot spot library initiative, as he makes his way from his humble home on the flats to visit the world's biggest book ship. This narrative anchors the story in Cape Town (no pun intended) while the main focus is on the wonderful initiative of a floating library, traveling the world to spread awareness about the importance of reading. It is not only a feature with current affairs spice, it is a whimsical tale of discovery while addressing one of the most important social ills of our time, illiteracy.


Extra Budget Items:
flights to Cape Town, car rental and accommodation for producer and possibly presenter.

metadata.One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...): a Floating library just hit our shores and it is entertaining young and old at the Cape Town Waterfront. We take a look inside.
metadata.Unique Selling Point: Its the biggest floating library in the world and it comes all the way from Germany. As part of its trip around Africa, it just anchored on Cape Town shores.
metadata.Summary: We take a look inside the Logos Hope floating library. With three stories of books, the ship offers a whimsical visit to the world of stories. We follow the excitement of an avid group of readers from the Cape Flats to the V&A waterfront as they explore a world of books they have never seen before.
metadata.Further information: The Hot spot library is a pop-up library in Kraaifontein just outside Cape Town. Started in 2017, membership has grown from only 30 children to over 800 in 2024. It aims to inspire and keep children off the streets. It tries to lure children into reading and all its benefits rather than choosing a life of gangsterism and drugs. We follow an avid reader whose life was changed by the Hot spot library initiative, as he makes his way from his humble home on the flats to visit the world's biggest book ship. This narrative anchors the story in Cape Town (no pun intended) while the main focus is on the wonderful initiative of a floating library, traveling the world to spread awareness about the importance of reading. It is not only a feature with current affairs spice, it is a whimsical tale of discovery while addressing one of the most important social ills of our time, illiteracy.
